purpose: Teach: 盧/洲/卿/大王/艦長/豪州/ムスリム/キリスト教徒

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、韓国元大統領盧氏の政策研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the policies of Roh, the former Korean president, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observant. Opens with gentle certainty—she's already read the work. Conversational pace, steady eye contact. The tone of a teacher checking in, not testing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、満洲、つまり旧満洲国洲の歴史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the history of Manchuria—the former Manchukuo, that is.
lines.style: Direct but uncertain. Slight hesitation before the clarification, as if Ren is already bracing for a follow-up question he didn't anticipate. Quiet, careful diction.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、英国貴族の卿、つまり卿位の歴史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the history of British nobility—the peerage system, specifically, didn't you?
lines.style: Gently probing. A measured pause before the question, like she's genuinely curious where his research led. Warm but slightly testing—she notices when students surprise her.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、古代の大王、つまり大王制の歴史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the history of ancient monarchy—the system of great kings, I mean.
lines.style: Quieter this time. Almost embarrassed at the disconnect between what he expected her to say and what he actually wrote about. A small internal correction in his voice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦艦の艦長の役割研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the role of battleship captains, didn't you?
lines.style: Still warm, but there's a slight tilt of amusement now. She's watching him realize the pattern. The rhythm slower, more deliberate—giving him space to catch up.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、豪州、つまりオーストラリアの先住民研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the history of Australia's indigenous peoples—the Aboriginal peoples, that is.
lines.style: Quiet alarm underneath. He's starting to sense something is wrong. The clarification comes faster this time, almost defensive. A slight tremor of self-doubt.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、ムスリム共同体の社会学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the sociology of Muslim communities, didn't you?
lines.style: Patient, knowing. She's letting him feel the full weight of it now. No rush. The words are simple and direct—the delivery is the kindness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、初期キリスト教徒の歴史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the history of early Christianity—the first Christians, I mean.
lines.style: Resignation in the opening breath. He stops trying to defend the mismatch. Flat, steady tone—acceptance that something has gone very wrong, but he's not sure how. A closing without closure.
